conflicts.where: Lesson 8 (watermelon slices at Gikomba Market, r = 20 cm, angles 80° and 160°)
conflicts.problem: The stated areas are wrong. For r = 20 cm, an 80° sector has area (80/360)×π×400 ≈ 279.25 cm², not 222.53 cm². A 160° sector has area ≈ 558.51 cm², not 445.06 cm². The prices (Ksh 1,112.65 and Ksh 2,225.30) are derived from the wrong areas. The 'exactly twice' ratio still holds, but the numbers do not match the formula used in the other lessons.
